message: The next morning, after the night had passed.

name: Mikoto
message: 「Alright, everyone, take your seats~」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Oh, it's rare for everyone to be here today. That's a good sign.」
Just as Sasaki-sensei said, all the students were in the classroom.

name: Mikoto
message: 「Well then, that makes five for Takamura Class, attendance checked...」
Sasaki-sensei marked the attendance register with a hologram.

name: Momiji
message: 「Wait a second.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Hm? What is it, Momiji?」

name: Momiji
message: 「That's strange, Takamura Class should only have four members.」
That's right, there were supposed to be four students in Takamura Class.

name: Mikoto
message: 「Shall I take roll call then？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「First, Suzakuin Momiji.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Present.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Next, Kazamine Setsugekka, Kazamine Keisetsu.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Y-yes.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Present.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Tobe Ririmu.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yeees.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「And finally, Kuki Asahi.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes!」

name: Mikoto
message: 「See? That makes five.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Who is that last person！？」

name: Iori
message: 「Wait a minute, Asahi-chan, why are you here！？」
To my surprise, Asahi was sitting quietly in the back.

name: Asahi
message: 「Even if you ask me why, I am a member of Takamura Class, after all.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Right, Sasaki-sensei」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Yeah, Kuki Asahi has been transferred into Takamura Class effective today」

name: Iori
message: 「Why？ What's going on！？」

name: Asahi
message: 「When I earnestly petitioned my previous homeroom teacher for a transfer to Takamura Class, they appreciated my enthusiasm and graciously granted my wish」

name: Iori
message: 「No, wait, Takamura Class has a notorious reputation for being nothing but problem students...？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Personally, I would appreciate it if you did something about that reputation first」

name: Iori
message: 「Sasaki-sensei, why was Asahi-chan transferred here？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「That's what she wanted. Couldn't be helped」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Besides, this Takamura Class is a fitting place for Kuki Asahi」

name: Momiji
message: 「What do you mean by 'fitting'？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Yesterday, this one marched up to her homeroom teacher and demanded to be transferred to Takamura Class」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Turns out Kuki had some dirt on the teacher. The whole thing came to light when the teacher started groveling on the floor」

name: Iori
message: 「Hey now...」

name: Mikoto
message: 「In the end, it was decided that a student who blackmails a teacher belongs in Takamura Class, so the transfer was approved」

name: Asahi
message: 「I'm so glad the transfer paperwork went through in a single day♪」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Man, you really play dirty~...」

name: Iori
message: 「Why go to such lengths just to get into Takamura Class...」

name: Asahi
message: 「That's obvious. It's because I want to receive your guidance, Iori-san」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ah, another strange one has joined us...」

name: Mikoto
message: 「And that concludes my report」

name: Mikoto
message: 「I'll leave the rest to our assistant homeroom teacher, Muragaki-sensei. I'm counting on you~」

name: Iori
message: 「H-Hey, wait a second！？」
There wasn't even a moment to stop her. Sasaki-sensei briskly slipped out of the classroom.
...Hmm, what am I supposed to do about this.
Would it be bad if I stepped out of the classroom for a second...? I really want a do-over.
Wait, what am I doing losing my nerve now！
Just yesterday, I swore I'd get these girls promoted to their second year no matter what.
As their teacher, I'm the one who has to lead them. Time to get my head in the game.

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, let me introduce myself properly！」

name: Iori
message: 「I'm Muragaki Iori, a member of the JGSDF's Tenju Special Forces Group！ I was dispatched here on a special appointment.」

name: Iori
message: 「We already met yesterday, so I figure you all recognize my face. Starting today, I'm officially in charge—pleasure working with you！」
Momiji stays stony-faced and doesn't even reply.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah, I don't think I can do this. This is way too embarrassing...！」
Setsugekka is fidgeting nervously.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Best of luck with teaching us.」
Keisetsu sounded somewhat condescending.
As for Ririmu and Asahi-chan...

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ooh, ooh！ Iorin, can I ask a question~？」

name: Asahi
message: 「'Iorin,' is it...」
Ririmu was overly familiar, while Asahi-chan looked oddly displeased.

name: Iori
message: 「W-What is it, Ririmu-san?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hey, Teach, do you have a girlfriend？」

name: Iori
message: 「No, I don't.」
Honestly, I've never even dated a woman before, though.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Then out of the five of us, who would you date？」

name: Iori
message: 「Come on, I'm here at this academy as a teacher. There's no way I'd date a student.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whoa~, what a stiff~」
What do you expect? It's a strict line of work.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whatever. More importantly, Iorin, did you come up with something？」

name: Iori
message: 「You mean a way to get stronger？ Not yet, no.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whaaat?! Then there was no point in coming to the classroom this early in the morning!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Look, I only dragged myself all the way here because you said you'd teach us, and I got my hopes up.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I sure hope you don't let those expectations down~」

name: Asahi
message: 「...Tobe Ririmu-san, was it?」

name: Asahi
message: 「From what I've been hearing, you've been taking quite an insolent attitude toward Iori-san, so」

name: Asahi
message: 「Just who on earth do you think you are？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Huh? Who do I think I am? The Honorable Student, duh.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Look, when I enrolled at this academy, I paid a stupidly high admission fee and tuition out of my own pocket.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「So I've got every right to demand service to match, obviously.」

name: Asahi
message: 「You do not.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Huh？ Why not？」

name: Asahi
message: 「I feel it is somewhat premature for someone of that sort, like yourself—who looks as though they throw their weight around in the nightlife district—to receive Iori-san's sublime instruction.」

name: Asahi
message: 「These days, I hear even kindergarteners have little lessons to cultivate self-control, so I would recommend you try receiving instruction there first.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「...Hey, you're picking a fight with me right now, aren't you？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Did you know？ Conflict only occurs between people on the same level.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Between you, who fail to properly understand the value of Iori-san's instruction, and myself, who understands its value more than thoroughly, I am afraid no conflict could possibly arise.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「What's that supposed to mean, are you trying to say I'm an idiot！？」

name: Iori
message: 「H-Hey, cut it out, both of you！」
I step between Asahi and Ririmu.

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi-chan, you're going a bit too far.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe, my apologies.」
Asahi, apologizing without the slightest shred of remorse.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ugh, enough already！ I'm so pissed, I can't deal with this！」

name: Iori
message: 「Hey, Ririmu-san, wait！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Look, Iorin, sorry, but I can't stand her. Call me once that woman is gone.」
Ririmu walked out.

name: Momiji
message: 「My, my... Looks like you're having a rough time right from your first day, Muragaki-sensei.」

name: Momiji
message: 「You'd better hurry and go follow up with Tobe Ririmu-san. It doesn't look like you have time to worry about the likes of me.」
Grrr... She looks way too pleased with herself.

name: Momiji
message: 「Oh, I'm completely self-reliant and don't need any support, so please don't worry about me.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I'll be doing some solo practice now, so please excuse me.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hold it right there！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Suzakuin Momiji, if you've got time for solo practice, then have a match with me！」

name: Momiji
message: 「...Ah! Is that Nakamura Sakura-san outside？!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Huh, where, where？！ Where's Sakura-san？！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hey, wait a second！ She's nowhere out there？！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Wait—Momiji's gone？！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「...Setsugekka, Momiji-san has already left.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Th-That jerk！ How dare you trick meee！！！」

name: Iori
message: 「H-Hey, you two！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Oh my... I'm being summoned.」
Keisetsu, briskly heading out of the classroom while pulling up a holographic display.

name: Iori
message: 「Whoa, wait, where are you going？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I told you yesterday, didn't I? I have work to attend to.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I'll leave Setsugekka in your care, alright?」
I stand there in a daze.
In the blink of an eye, it was just Asahi-chan and me left in the classroom.

name: Asahi
message: 「We're finally all alone together, Iori-san!」

name: Iori
message: 「No, no, that's not what's going on here, okay？！」

name: Asahi
message: 「I'm in the best mood ever now that I have you all to myself, Iori-san.」

name: Iori
message: 「Agh... Seriously, every single one of them...！」
Day 2 of my mission. It hit home all over again.
That this place, Takamura Class—was nothing but a gathering of problem children no ordinary teacher could ever handle.
